summary: Learn to prioritize digital investments, build roadmaps, and govern portfolio value. Explore the course and strengthen your executive routines.
lede: Digital portfolio management training helps executives, PMO leaders, and transformation teams compare investments against strategic priorities. Participants build ranked scorecards using weighted criteria, assess investment cases through NPV and payback assumptions, map dependencies into roadmaps, and assign owners to measurable benefits. The course also introduces conceptual AI-assisted scenario analysis and portfolio reporting with data-quality checks.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for leaders and practitioners who shape digital investment choices, manage portfolio-level delivery, or report transformation progress to executive decision-makers.
modules: Power BI Value Tracking and Reporting
prerequisites: Prior exposure to strategy execution, project or program delivery, PMO work, or digital investment decisions is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use portfolio templates and spreadsheet-based calculations; advanced AI-assisted portfolio analysis is introduced at conceptual awareness level.
